## Ingredients

- Chicken
- Salt and pepper
- Flour

#### Sauce

- 3 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1 piece ginger
- 2 pieces garlic
- 1 piece green onion
- 1 ½ tablespoons sugar
- 1 ½ tablespoons oyster sauce
- A little sesame oil

## Directions

1. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
1. Coat the chicken in flour.

## Notes

- The photo cuts off after "flour chicken," so the rest of the directions are missing: how the chicken is cooked (pan-fried is likely, given the flour) and when the sauce goes in.
- The cut and amount of chicken aren't given.
- "Piece" of ginger, garlic, and green onion probably means a slice of ginger, cloves of garlic, and one stalk of green onion. The card doesn't say whether to chop them.
- "Sesame oil" is partly smudged.
